name: Colonial Pipeline
rootCause: On May 7, 2021, Colonial Pipeline, the largest oil and gas pipeline operator in the United States, was targeted by a ransomware attack. The ransomware attack involved national critical infrastructure, which caused global shock and widespread concern. Was blackmailed to pay 5 million U.S. dollars worth of Bitcoin. Court documents show that the government recovered 63.7 bitcoins ($2.3 million).
